config.notes: P2 pseudo-RAW (three collocated channels, no CFA phase) motion training arm at the FORMAL budget. Identical to the CFA formal arm (configs/encoders/n01_full/p2_motion_train.json) in seeds, budget, validation interval and monitor, delta_val, LR schedule, optimizer, checkpoint, diagnostics and evaluation buckets: the two formal arms differ only in the input domain (data.input_mode synthetic_cfa -> rawvla_rgb3, the CFA 256x256 sensor geometry override removed in favour of the shipped pseudo_raw_geometry 128x128 with channel_phase=[], and data.recipe_scale 4.0 -> 2.0 to preserve the declared relative scene at that resolution) plus the label fields stage/notes (scale stays 'formal' on both). The same three seeds 101/211/307 and the same 100k first segment (ceiling 300k) apply, so the arm is a formal-budget result and the CFA-vs-pseudo-RAW comparison is budget-matched.

condition_descriptions.real_improvement_over_run: first_value - best_value must be strictly greater than delta_val
condition_descriptions.two_effective_lr_drops: at least two effective LR drops must have been applied
condition_descriptions.final_low_lr_phase: the run must be in the final low-LR phase
condition_descriptions.flat_tail_below_delta_val: the last plateau_checks improvements must each be below delta_val
condition_descriptions.best_not_at_budget_end: the best checkpoint must not sit inside the last plateau_checks validation windows of the budget
condition_descriptions.diagnostics_passed: the small-set fit / input / gradient diagnostics must pass
